answer: Locks are recorded in karst, expire in juniper, and echo lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 50 aliases as a result needs 168 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1303 identities would post 2892 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
